My friend Eric left this comment in reply to my Barney Miller/Trilateral Commission post and I think its brilliant insight:

"Nailed it. Talking about white people conspiring behind closed doors at the highest levels triggers most white peoples' (even mainstream progressives) "PROTECT THE QUEEN AND THE HIVE" instinct. Maybe it's time to start thinking of conspiracy deniers as co-conspirators, and hound them for their complicity in mass murder. Knowing white people though, they'd just make a show of huffing and puffing while secretly enjoying thinking of themselves as big, badass mass murderers. Fucking bourgeois psychology... "

A bow-tie cost a young man his life on the streets of Chicago. Apparently the bow-tie is part of the school uniform, and he showed up to school having forgotten his.  The school, rigid in its dress-code, sent the young man home, 18 years old.  I blame both the streets and the school on this one but more the school. Our high school had a dress code: collared oxford shirts, slacks and dress shoes --neither jeans nor tennies.  However, when students did arrive out of dress code, the staff assumed the student was trying to get sent home, and was sent to class anyway, with an added 45 minutes to an hour of detention after school.  There are good people still in Chicago's schools but I really can not get a read on the myriad charter schools that have popped up since my residency there. Mendel Catholic, my alma mater, evolved from the remnants of Pullman Tech, then merged with several other catholic schools a few years later to save money and sell of properties --very forward thinking of them.  Mendel became St. Martin de Porres for a few years and is now a charter run by CPS called the Gwendolyn Brooks Academy.  What kind of educator sacrifices a day of learning over a bow-tie.  Tragic fail by "Excel" Academy.

The most tragic things about the "coonery" of men like Shaq, and Jerry Rice, and Kid Rock, because coons come in all colors, and other black people who are so ensconced in corporate western culture, is their ability influence their fans to be as mindless as them, particularly regarding the African Diaspora.  Those of us who've spent time in the trenches of the movement use words like boycotts, and Pan-Africanism and unity and watch our fb friends abandon ship, till  you're left with those four or five die-hards who sleep with their black fists raised.  Yet we are part of a larger Diaspora, one that requires us to get our shit together here so we can help our brothers and sisters in the Motherland.  The beneficiaries of our  physical and mental separation from Her are the same colonial and neo-colonial culprits of  years past. Deep pocketed Chinese and Westerners hell-bent on hunting Africa's wildlife to extinction.  Violent armies of every ism and religion holding large swaths of the continent hostage in order to continue stealing the continents vast wealth.   By being desirable of the unattainable we have left Africa vulnerable to exploitation that is nearly impossible to calculate, and we turn our backs on the people and the wildlife that make our planet the rare jewel that it is.

Another black child is killed by the police in Ohio. Reports say he pulled out a pellet gun though I know he would have been shot for pulling out a gummy bear.  Well, until there is video I am going to do the sane thing and take the police report with a shaker of salt. And I know some of the bigots who find my page will say he had a pellet gun, blah blah blah.   Rest in Heaven Tyree King:
